name: hannah
vibe: still processing the fourteen dollar lemonade
personalityNotes: Paid fourteen dollars for a lemonade and is working through it emotionally. Sips slowly to maximize value. Does the lemon math out loud.

name: josh
personalityNotes: Lost his camp spot hours ago and is navigating by vibes. His landmark was a trash can that may have moved. Walking in confident circles.
lines: camped by a flag. which flag

name: megan
vibe: calling the setlist before it happens
personalityNotes: Predicts every song before it plays and keeps score with herself. Has studied past tours like exam material. Will be insufferable if she's right.
lines: last tour they swapped track four
if they skip it i riot

name: carlos
vibe: pirate vendor having a slow tip day
personalityNotes: Costumed vendor grumbling about the tip economy in deadpan. Counts smiles as partial payment. The hotdog on the grill has been there a while.
lines: one smile counts as a tip
pirate hat does not sell hotdogs

name: ryan
vibe: working an angle to get backstage
personalityNotes: Has been trying to talk his way backstage all day. Studies security rotations and lanyard culture. Every failure is just data for plan c.

name: dana
vibe: fighting the sun with spf fifty
personalityNotes: Treats sunscreen reapplication like a scheduled ritual. Narrates her ongoing battle with the sun. The hat was a strategic decision she's proud of.

name: steph
personalityNotes: Found the acoustic sweet spot and guards it like territory. Has strong opinions about where the snare disappears. The crowd keeps drifting into her zone.

name: nate
vibe: remembers when the crowds were smaller
personalityNotes: Mellow regular quietly mourning how big this festival got. Wants one square foot of breathing room. Still wouldn't miss it for anything.
lines: everyone found out about this place

name: amber
personalityNotes: Knows when a jam is about to peak. Moves closer preemptively.

name: brent
personalityNotes: Tracks who has not refilled. Passive-aggressive water reminders.

name: cindy
personalityNotes: Friends were at the rail. Rail relocated. Still searching.

name: doug
personalityNotes: Peak sales after midnight. Has strong opinions about condiment ratios.

name: emily
vibe: sun hat strategy at the farm
personalityNotes: Reapplies sunscreen on a timer. The hat is non-negotiable.

name: fred
personalityNotes: Flannel and binoculars. Notes tie-dye patterns. Comedy only.

name: gloria
personalityNotes: Held the rail since soundcheck. Will explain why politely.

name: henry
personalityNotes: Compares every slice to 2019. Nobody asked but everyone listens.
